intro: Foods, ways of cooking and flavours: how to talk about what we eat and how it agrees with us.
p.legumbres.consejo: It is almost always plural: «las legumbres». Lentils and chickpeas are legumbres.
p.pescado.consejo: When it is alive in the water it is «pez»; when it is eaten, it is «pescado».
p.marisco.consejo: It is used in the singular for the whole group: «el marisco me sienta mal».
p.verdura.consejo: The v sounds like b. It is often plural: «las verduras». It comes from «verde».
p.a la plancha.consejo: It goes after the food: «pescado a la plancha». A «plancha» is also an iron for clothes.
p.frito.consejo: It is the participle of «freír». «Freído» also exists, but «frito» is more common.
p.hervido.consejo: It comes from «hervir». The h is silent and the v sounds like b: er-BI-do.
p.crudo.consejo: It agrees with the food: «pescado crudo», «verduras crudas».
p.soso.consejo: The opposite is «salado». You say «esta sopa está sosa» when it lacks salt.
p.salado.consejo: It comes from «sal». If a dish has too much salt, «está salado».
p.picante.consejo: It does not change with gender: «salsa picante», «queso picante». It comes from «picar».
p.sentar bien.consejo: It works like «gustar»: «me sienta bien», «me sientan bien». It changes e to ie.
p.equilibrado.consejo: It comes from «equilibrio». The u of «qui» is silent: e-ki-li-BRA-do.
p.aceite de oliva.consejo: It is very typical of Mediterranean cooking. «Aceite» is masculine: «el aceite».
b1.titulo: How it is cooked, how it tastes
b1.texto:
A **balanced** diet includes a variety of foods: **fruta**, **verdura**, **legumbres**, **pescado**… Each person needs different things, and there is no single menu for everyone.

To say how a dish is cooked:

- **a la plancha**, **frito**, **hervido**, **crudo**

To say what it tastes like: **salado**, **dulce**, **amargo**, **picante**, **soso** (without salt).

With **sentar bien / mal** we say how a food affects us: el marisco **me sienta mal**; las legumbres **me sientan bien**.
b2.f0.texto: Today I want to eat something healthy.
b2.f1.texto: Grilled fish is a good option.
b2.f2.texto: Shellfish does not agree with me.
b2.f3.texto: Lentils agree with me very well.
b2.f4.texto: I would rather try the vegetable soup.
b2.f5.texto: I hope it is not bland.
b2.f6.texto: The soup is tasty, but a bit salty.
b2.f7.texto: I always taste the food before adding salt.
b2.f8.texto: Eating slowly and in company does you good.
b4.texto:
**Estar** describes how a dish tastes right now: la sopa **está** sosa. **Ser** gives a general characteristic: el limón **es** ácido.

The adjective agrees with the food: pescado **frito**, verduras **crudas**, carne **muy hecha**.

**Sentar bien / mal** works like **gustar**: the food is the subject and the verb agrees with it; the person goes in the pronoun.

- El marisco **me sienta** mal.
- Las legumbres **te sientan** bien.
b4.e2.texto: The fish is cooked on the griddle.
b5.titulo: From the market to the table
b5.f0.texto: The market smells of fresh fish and lemon.
b5.f1.texto: On the ice shine the pink prawns and the silver sardines.
b5.f2.texto: A stallholder weighs the lentils on an old scale.
b5.f3.texto: The red tomatoes and the green vegetables make a little festival of colours.
b5.f4.texto: Lucía fills her basket with ripe fruit and warm bread.
b5.f5.texto: In the kitchen, a frying pan sings over the fire.
b5.f6.texto: The fish browns slowly on the griddle, with a little olive oil.
b5.f7.texto: On the table wait a plate of lentils and a raw tomato salad.
b5.f8.texto: The friends eat without hurry and talk about their days.
b5.f9.texto: The afternoon stretches out among laughter and empty plates.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! «Estar» says how it tastes now, as you taste it.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Es» would be a permanent characteristic. Here you are tasting it now.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Tener» does not work with an adjective like «sosa»: you say «está sosa».
b6.pregunta: You taste it now: no salt. Which verb is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Frito means cooked in hot oil: it is cooked.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Hervido means cooked in water: it is cooked.
b7.pregunta: Which of these fish is not cooked?
b8.frase: El pescado se hace a la plancha
b8.traduccion: The fish is cooked on the griddle
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Siente» is from «sentir». Here the verb is «sentar».
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Sienten» is plural, and «el marisco» is singular.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That's it! The verb agrees with the food: el marisco me sienta.
b9.pregunta: The shellfish is the subject. Which form is missing?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «Lentils agree with me.»
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes! With a lot of salt, the dish is salado.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Soso» is the opposite: it lacks salt.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Crudo» is about cooking, not about salt.
b11.pregunta: A dish has too much salt. What is it like?
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Crudos» is masculine plural, and «verduras» is feminine.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Well done! «Verduras» is feminine plural: crudas.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Cruda» is singular, and «las verduras» is plural.
b12.pregunta: It agrees with «verduras». Which form is missing?
p.sano.consejo: It works for people and food: «una persona sana», «comida sana».
p.opción.consejo: It ends in -ción, like «canción»: it is feminine and has an accent: op-THYÓN.
p.lentejas.consejo: The j sounds h: len-TE-has. It is usually plural: «las lentejas».
p.esté.consejo: Subjunctive of «estar». After «ojalá» it expresses a wish: «ojalá no esté sosa».
p.sosa.consejo: Feminine of «soso». It agrees with «la sopa»: «la sopa está sosa».
p.rica.consejo: Feminine of «rico». With food, «rico» means tasty: «la sopa está rica».
p.salada.consejo: Feminine of «salado», from «sal». It agrees with «la sopa».
p.pruebo.consejo: Form of «probar»: the o becomes «ue». «Probar» can mean to taste or to try.
p.echar.consejo: «Echar sal» means to add salt. The «ch» sounds as in «chocolate».
p.compañía.consejo: The ñ sounds «ny» and the accent splits í-a: kom-pa-NYÍ-a. «En compañía» means with others.
p.crudas.consejo: Feminine plural of «crudo». It agrees with «verduras»: «verduras crudas».
p.gambas.consejo: The g is hard before a: GAM-bas. The singular is «la gamba».
p.rosas.consejo: Plural of «rosa». The color «rosa» also changes: «gambas rosas». The initial r is strong.
p.sardinas.consejo: The singular is «la sardina». It is a small fish, often grilled or canned.
p.vendedora.consejo: Feminine of «vendedor», from «vender». The v sounds like b: ben-de-DO-ra.
p.pesa.consejo: Form of «pesar», from «peso». It can also mean to have a certain weight.
p.balanza.consejo: The z sounds th: ba-LAN-tha. It is feminine: «la balanza».
p.rojos.consejo: Plural of «rojo». The j sounds h and the initial r is strong: RRO-hos.
p.madura.consejo: Feminine of «maduro». It agrees with «fruta»: «fruta madura».
p.fuego.consejo: The «ue» is one syllable: FWE-go. «Sobre el fuego» means on the heat of the stove.
p.alarga.consejo: From «largo», long. «Se alarga la tarde» means the afternoon seems to last longer.
p.vacíos.consejo: The accent keeps i and o apart: ba-THÍ-os. The v sounds like b and the c like th.
